Name: Bats and Mushrooms Farm Cave
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This is a Content Patcher content pack for Farm Cave Framework that adds an option to the farm cave event to let you grow mushrooms and receive fruit from the farm cave.

If you have already chosen a farm cave, you can reset the event using Farm Cave Framework.

This mod requires the following mods to work:

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10506]Farm Cave Framework[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[/list]
